Former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zayne Carrick]] owned a '''lightsaber''' that replaced the [[Zayne Carrick's first lightsaber|first lightsaber]] he originally owned during his membership with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. His new [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] produced a [[Color/Legends|blue]] blade, different from the yellow shine of its predecessor, and was etched with the names of his former classmates; the victims of the [[Padawan Massacre]] of Taris. The lightsaber's crystal was formed by fusing the deceased padawan's crystals together.
